; these files were part of it before the
slim base. It installs them at the same paths in UP-Term: (bin, share, licenses): no new drawer, no
change of the path. In an UP-Term window, in vsh:
  vim file.txt
licenses_notes:
These files were part of up-term.lha until the slim base (P9); the package installs them at the
  same paths in UP-Term:. Its row of SOURCES.txt is in UP-Term:licenses/vim/SOURCES.txt.

The complete source with UP-Term's patches and build recipes is up-term-src.lha, published next to
  up-term.lha.
